items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names state their purpose (decodeIndexCell, readCount, setDecodeErr, decodeAllocChunk), the wire format is documented in a header comment, and public Encode/Decode have doc comments. Short names (e, d, l, p) follow existing Go and package style.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Ignores the conventions: invents its own shapeTypePointVector... constants instead of using typeTag, and puts all per-shape codecs in shapeindex_encode.go rather than lax_*.go/loop.go. decodeIndexLoop/Polygon duplicate existing decoders. File is 498 lines, close to the cap.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Every count passes through readCount(limit), allocations are capped with min(n, decodeAllocChunk), and shape IDs, cell order/overlap and edge IDs are checked. The target index is unchanged on error. The recover() is a documented last resort. Truncation, corruption and fuzz tests are included.

items.name: Existing encodings and Shape interface unchanged
items.name_zh: 既有编码格式与 Shape 接口不变
items.evidence: Purely additive: new file only. Existing per-shape wire formats, typeTag values and the Shape interface are unchanged. It uses private shapeType constants instead of new typeTags, so nothing is renumbered.
